assessment.reason: The projection clears 4.5 by about one combined rebound and assist, but it rests on an unusually light 22.3-minute estimate. Several Pelicans teammates carry listings running through game day, so his role is unsettled.
assessment.model_case: The projection is about 5.5 with a median of 5, so the over needs only modest volume. The weakness is the minutes input. The model ignores teammate absences, so it is unclear whether 22.3 minutes reflects a real bench role or misses the extra usage from the guard injury.
assessment.price_case: At +106 on the main line, the over breaks even just under half the time. Only one other book is available for comparison, and the blended figure sits barely above break-even. A thin, single-book reference cannot confirm the large gap between the model and the market.
assessment.context_case: Murray's absence could add ball-handling for DeRozan. Four frontcourt and wing teammates are listed out through Nov 14, so tonight's 7:10 PM ET rotation is unclear. DeRozan himself is not shown in the excerpt, which does not establish that he is healthy.
blocking_checks: Whether Murphy, Missi, Watford and McGowens play tonight. Their returns could cut DeRozan's minutes and rebounds, while continued absences could push him above the 22.3-minute projection.

qualitative_review.countercase: If the light minutes projection reflects a real reduced role, 4.5 is close to fair. Returning frontcourt players would also take away rebounds. The model's edge may simply come from ignoring lineup changes the book has already priced. This bet is correlated with the assists over and is not independent confirmation.

findings.note: DeRozan is a Denver bench player who has played about 19–22 minutes a game lately. His rebounds plus assists in recent games were 5, 6, 6 and 1, and his listed season averages of 1.9 rebounds and 3.0 assists add up to just 4.9. That's barely above the 4.5 line, and one game was a clear miss.

He was a late scratch on Nov 4 with lower-back spasms and was listed as questionable again on Nov 9 before playing. That makes another late scratch or limited minutes a real risk. I found no injury status for this Nov 14 game, so check the final injury report.

Over his last five games he averaged 3.6 assists and 1.6 rebounds in 24.2 minutes, about 5.2 combined, which is above the 4.5 line. Other reports say he's Denver's sixth man, and Alpha Diallo, Bryce Hopkins and Trevon Brazile are the backups who would take his minutes.

Covers' model for the Oct 28 Nuggets-Pelicans game projected DeRozan for about 3.2 assists and made no strong call on assists. Books then had his line mostly at 3.5, so an even-money-or-better Over 2.5 now may mean the market expects less from him. Check his current role and injury status.
In the Oct 28, 2026 game at New Orleans, the same matchup and venue, the official box score shows DeRozan with 5 assists in about 26 minutes, clearing 2.5, even though he shot 1-for-6.
A CBS analysis of his August 2026 signing said Denver's offense runs through Jokic's playmaking and expected DeRozan to mainly lead the bench as a scorer, which could limit his assist chances.
